environment.description: py-sc-fermi 根据预先计算的缺陷形成能、电子态密度和晶胞体积，通过电中性条件自洽求解稀释极限下的费米能级、缺陷及电子和空穴浓度。它提供缺陷电荷态、缺陷种类、态密度和缺陷系统对象，支持平衡及指定冻结浓度的准平衡分析与数据读写。

init_ref_tools.name: DefectSystem
init_ref_tools.description: This class is used to calculate the self consistent Fermi energy for a defective material, observing the condition of charge neutrality and therefore, point defect and carrier concentrations under equilibrium conditions.  Args: defect_species (list[DefectSpecies]): List of ``DefectSpecies`` objects which are present in the ``DefectSystem``. volume (float): volume of the unit cell in Angstroms cubed dos (DOS): the ``DOS`` object associated with the unit cell temperature (float): temperature at which self-consistent Fermi energy will be solved for. convergence_tolerance (float, optional): Tolerance for the Fermi energy convergence in eV. If not specified, uses scipy's default. n_trial_steps (int, optional): Deprecated. Previously set the maximum number of solver iterations. The solver now uses Brent's method which converges reliably without this parameter.

source_metadata.selection_rule: Latest official GitHub Release returned at checked_on; checkout its tag, not the default branch

python_source_extraction.selection: public module classes/functions; __init__ and public source-defined class methods (including properties)
python_source_extraction.excluded: private definitions, non-constructor magic methods, imported/inherited APIs, nested definitions, external dependencies; tests/examples outside package directories

docstring_mapping.description: summary before Google/NumPy sections or reStructuredText fields
docstring_mapping.input: signature parameters; annotation types with docstring fallback; Google/NumPy/reStructuredText parameter descriptions
docstring_mapping.output: Returns/Yields or reStructuredText return/rtype; null if undocumented
docstring_mapping.ori_input: AST-rendered parameters, or DEVSIM native documented signature parameters
docstring_mapping.ori_description: complete normalized source docstring or native embedded documentation

python_source_extraction.missing_values: Undocumented text is an empty string; missing return sections and self/cls entries are null; missing lists are empty
